# Antigravity Context Ring

> Native inline context window monitor and real-time Connect-RPC token telemetry for Google Antigravity IDE.

## Problem Statement
In Google Antigravity IDE, developers lack real-time visibility into active context window usage. Although underlying foundation models natively support 1M to 2M tokens via official APIs, Antigravity's client environment enforces an automated server-side context compaction (Auto-Compaction) and physical truncation limit at 128K tokens (Pro series) or 256K tokens (Flash & Claude series) to throttle subscription quota consumption and manage GPU memory. Reaching this 256K ceiling triggers silent, lossy summarization—the true root cause behind Gemini's sudden mid-task amnesia and hallucination—resulting in irreversible loss of earlier architectural context without prior warning.

## Key Architecture Specifications
- Non-Invasive CDP Runtime: Zero binary modification. Never alters or unpacks resources/app.asar. Connects via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) to inject an isolated vanilla JavaScript/SVG microkernel (19px SVG ring).
- Hardware Ground Truth: Communicates with the local Antigravity Language Server over Connect-RPC. Reads actual modelUsage metadata (prompt tokens, completion tokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens). No heuristic character guessing.
- Three-Tier Model Decoupling: Separates selectedModel (UI primary model, uniquely dictates capacity denominator), executionModel (subtask execution model), and checkpointModel (trajectory snapshot model). Prevents lightweight subagents (e.g., flash_lite) from distorting the denominator.
- Dual-Tier SWR & Never-Reset Guard: In-memory LRU cache (50 sessions) + persistent LocalStorage cache (100 sessions). Renders valid historical snapshots in 0ms on session switch. Holds last-known verified state on transient host disconnects rather than blinking to zero.
- Split View Isolation: Each visible composer container maintains an independent state-machine lifecycle (Map<box, PaneRingInstance>) binding directly to its React Fiber node, guaranteeing zero cross-pane pollution.
- Resource Footprint: Background Node.js sidecar consumes ~18MB RAM and near-0% CPU, regulated by 250ms debounced event coalescing and an automated host watchdog.

## Supported Models & Physical Truncation Thresholds
- Gemini 4 Argon: 256K (262,144 tokens)
- Gemini 3.8 Flash: 256K (262,144 tokens)
- Claude 5.5 (Opus / Sonnet): 256K (262,144 tokens)
- Claude 4.6 / 4.5 (Sonnet / Opus / Thinking): 160K (163,840 tokens)
- Gemini 3.1 Pro: 128K (131,072 tokens)
- GPT-OSS 120B: 80K (81,920 tokens)

## Installation & CLI Commands
Clone repository:
git clone https://github.com/brien9/antigravity-context-ring.git
cd antigravity-context-ring

Install on Windows (PowerShell):
.\install.ps1

Install on macOS / Linux:
sh ./install.sh

Universal Node.js CLI Manager:
node manage.mjs install    # Hot-inject sidecar daemon into running host
node manage.mjs status     # Audit runtime daemon health and CDP connection
node manage.mjs uninstall  # Clean rollback with zero filesystem residue
